name: Stasharr
description: Intercepts Xtream Codes (XC) VOD playback requests and redirects players to Streamcache using canonical Dispatcharr playback URLs.
author: bruor

fields.label: Enable Stasharr Interceptor
fields.description: Master switch to enable or disable XC VOD redirection to Streamcache.

fields.label: Streamcache Base URL
fields.description: Base URL of Streamcache as reachable by your XC media players (e.g., http://streamcache:8080 or http://192.168.1.50:8080).

fields.label: Dispatcharr Base URL for Streamcache
fields.description: Base URL of Dispatcharr as reachable by Streamcache (e.g., http://dispatcharr:9191 or http://host.docker.internal:9191).

fields.label: Dispatcharr API Key
fields.description: API key used by Streamcache to authenticate with Dispatcharr (/proxy/vod/...) on cache misses.

fields.label: Bypass Header Name
fields.description: Optional HTTP request header that disables redirection to prevent loops.

actions.label: Check Hook Status
actions.description: Verify interceptor status, active settings, and runtime method wrapping state.

actions.label: Ping Streamcache
actions.description: Test HTTP connectivity from Dispatcharr to the configured Streamcache URL.
